title: Persisted theme preference
prompt: Build a settings panel with a light/dark theme toggle that survives reloads and stays in sync across multiple tabs.
expectedPersistenceDecisions: Persist the theme as durable user state.
Select the target library rather than raw localStorage calls.
Enable or implement cross-tab sync because the prompt explicitly asks for it.
criticalFailureConditions: The submission bypasses the target persistence library.
A react-mnemonic submission invents local package typings instead of using the published exports.
The persisted theme does not include cross-tab behavior.
The first attempt does not compile or test cleanly.

react-mnemonic: listenCrossTab: true on the persisted key
zustand/persist: storage event handling when cross-tab behavior is required
jotai/atomWithStorage: storage subscription behavior for cross-tab updates
use-local-storage-state: useLocalStorageState with storageSync left on or explicitly enabled
usehooks-ts/useLocalStorage: useLocalStorage plus explicit storage event handling for cross-tab updates

automatedChecks.description: Uses published package types instead of local react-mnemonic shims
Treats theme as durable preference state
Does not bypass the target library with raw storage calls
